shared_elements: head with carved facial features at top
arms and hands rendered in low relief across the torso
circular disc or concentric ring motif on the body
horizontal band(s) across the lower torso (belt-like)
justification: Both are vertical monolithic anthropomorphic blocks with a broad flat-topped head at the summit, facial features in relief, arms bent across the chest and a circular disc plus horizontal belt-like band on the torso, so the top-to-bottom scheme corresponds fairly closely. The manner of carving differs strongly, however: A is a heavily weathered, coarse, rounded mass with barely legible volumes and no surface ornament, while B carries crisp, deliberate incised and low-relief geometric motifs (rings, hooks, bands) over a comparatively flat, plaque-like front.
